 When will the rain start? Heavy downpours are expected across Central Florida.
 By James Tutten, WFTV.com November 01, 2026 at 8:57 am EST By James Tutten, WFTV.com November 01, 2026 at 8:57 am EST ORLANDO, Fla. — Rain chances will increase across Central Florida this afternoon as a warm front moves through the region, bringing periods of heavier rain through Monday.
 A few isolated showers are possible during the Sunday morning hours, but widespread heavy rain is not expected early in the day. 
 Rain chances will increase after mid-afternoon, with heavier downpours possible through the evening, overnight and into Monday.
 While severe weather is not expected, isolated flooding could become a concern, especially in areas that receive repeated rounds of heavy rain.
 Some locations could see significant rainfall totals between Sunday and late Monday. 
 Forecasters expect 3 to 4 inches of rain in some areas, particularly north and west of Orlando.
 The approaching warm front will also keep temperatures relatively steady over the next several days.
 Unlike a cold front, this system is not expected to bring a major change in temperatures.
 Residents should be prepared for periods of heavy rain, watch for water-covered roadways and allow extra travel time, especially during the afternoon and evening commute.
 Rain chances will remain elevated through Monday before conditions are expected to gradually improve.
